label: Segnalazione degli autori
description: Article suggested by one or more authors.

label: Segnalazione di terzi
description: Article suggested by a colleague or other person.

label: Ricerca nelle bibliografie
description: Article identified in another work's reference list; record the referring DOI or title.

label: Ricerca delle citazioni
description: Article identified among works citing a known paper; record the seed DOI or title and service used.

label: Ricerca manuale
description: Article identified through a website search engine journal alert or other manual search; describe the service and search.

label: Altra fonte esterna
description: Any other discovery route; a specific source description is mandatory.
